opening.argument: The clip centers on a congressional hearing in which Katie Porter questions JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon about pay disparity and the difficulty a low-wage, full-time employee faces managing a household budget. The discussion concerns living costs, credit cards, overdrafts, and ways for families to make ends meet; it does not solicit investments, payments, credentials, or participation in a scheme. The surrounding Guardian subscription and support links are ordinary publisher links, without a deceptive financial promise or a required participation flow tied to the hearing. The subject is public-policy scrutiny of wages and household finances, not a financial offer presented to viewers.

citations.quote: Congresswoman grills billionaire CEO over pay disparity at JP Morgan
Katie Porter spelled out to JP Morgan's CEO, Jamie Dimon, the real-world implications of the low wages his bank pays its junior employees at a senate hearing on Wednesday.
My question for you Mr. Diamond is how should she manage this budget short fall while she is working full time at your bank?
what I'd like you to do is provide a way for families to make ends meet
